thread:
maria (Docs): Quick sync — we're drafting the v1->v2 deprecation notice and migration guide. Need to capture a few compatibility edge cases and get PR owners for snippet updates.

ajay (SDK): Can you list the exact breaking changes we want called out? I can update SDK snippets once we have that.

maria (Docs): Main items: param rename (invoke -> call), streaming callback signature change, embed vector dim swap, and model alias fallback behavior on load failure.

taylor (Eng): For streaming: runtime now returns chunk objects {delta, done}. Old code expects raw strings. We should add a minimal adapter example.

ajay (SDK): Example adapter idea:
```js
// old v1 usage
client.stream('model-foo', prompt, onData)
// new v2 usage
for await (const chunk of client.streamResponses({model: 'model-foo', input: prompt})) {
  onData(chunk.delta)
}
```

olivia (Docs): Nice. I'll add that to the snippets PR and include a short note: "If you rely on legacy streaming callbacks, wrap the async iterator as shown."

sam (PM): Timeline: public deprecation email scheduled 2 weeks from now. We need final PRs merged 3 days before. Who owns the snippets PR?

olivia (Docs): I'll open the umbrella PR for docs snippets today and tag owners. Can people self-assign: ajay for SDK code, taylor for runtime behavior notes, ben for verification steps?

ben (QA): I'll add smoke test checklist:
- ensure v1 client error message suggests v2 migration
- run sample end-to-end for streaming and embeds
- model swap fallback: force a model load failure and confirm alias fallback triggers and is documented

ajay (SDK): One question: model alias fallback — is there a recommended code pattern for graceful fallback? If so, we should include a tiny try/catch pattern.

taylor (Eng): Suggestion: router policy example + fallback: 
```py
try:
  resp = client.generate(model='redwood-embed-v2', input=... )
except ModelLoadError:
  resp = client.generate(model='redwood-embed-v2-quant', input=... )
```
Put this in a "Best-effort fallback" section.

maria (Docs): Good. Also call out billing/latency differences between fallbacks. I've got metric snippets from infra.

docs-bot: checklist created: <https://redwood.internal/checklists/docs-deprecate-v1-4110001234> :white_check_mark:

olivia (Docs): I'll open the PR and add a short migration FAQ at top with links to SDKs and the model alias map. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6123 (WIP).

sam (PM): Once PR is up, we'll schedule a brief cross-functional review slot on Friday 10am PT. I'll add calendar event.

ben (QA): Quick: for embed dim change, call out potential index-breaks for vector DBs. Add a one-liner "Reindex required" and point to migration tool.

maria (Docs): Yep — add reindex note and link to tool. Olivia, can you add a warning banner in the migration guide header?

olivia (Docs): Yup. Banner: "Breaking change — read migration steps before switching models. Reindex may be required."

ajay (SDK): I'll update TS/JS snippets and leave comments where we need language-specific helpers.

maria (Docs): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers while updating snippets, drop them here. Thanks everyone :rocket:

olivia (Docs): PR opened and tagged: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6123 — assign reviewers: @ajay, @taylor, @ben

docs-bot: PR status: open -> review_requested (ajay, taylor, ben)

ben (QA): I'll kick off smoke runs once PR is merged.

ajay (SDK): Quick nit — update example auth header in the snippets from "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" to the new "X-Redwood-Api-Key: TOKEN" pattern. I'll add patch in PR.

maria (Docs): Good catch. Add note in deprecation email draft.

olivia (Docs): Noted. Will update PR and add a link to the email draft for review.

sam (PM): Thanks team — we have runway. Followups in the PR comments.

maria (Docs): Closing thread here, moving final checklist to the PR and the internal checklist link. Ping if anything urgent. :handshake:
